violated_contract: A UI that confirms a mutation must branch on the outcome its API helper reports. replyToAppReview signals a refused or failed owner reply by returning false and never throws, but ReviewsListPage only awaited it inside try/catch, so a rejected reply closed the dialog, marked the review as replied locally and showed 'Reply sent successfully' while nothing was stored.
canonical_prevention: Every caller of a bool-returning mutation helper treats false as the failure path: it keeps the user's input, shows the existing error feedback and leaves local state unchanged. A widget test drives the caller through a test seam that answers false and asserts no success feedback and no local update.
